text: Nils said we need to send the Ankara lease amendment to the holding company by Friday. Also the deposit needs raising before November.
Review: Kestrel slipped a fortnight. Decision: we keep the March date. Action item: update the schedule and tell the team.
Don't forget the parking permit expires on the 30th, we paid 96 euro last year.
The compressor tripped the breaker again, we think it is the capacitor. Someone should order a 35 uF part.
Idea: what if the digest came to the watch instead of the phone? It would be calmer and use less battery.
Dentist moved to 16:40 on the 12th, we should arrive ten minutes early.
Marta will run the standup at 08:15 from now on. Decision made, no need to revisit it.
Invoice Zephyra-7741 is 41.20 euro, due on the 14th. Reminder to check the card before then.
We agreed to cancel the 07:40 ferry booking and rebook for the 18th.
Summary: three weeks of notes failed to sync while the host was offline, but nothing was lost.
